title: Low poly helicopter shooter
author: alfonzodibonzo
selftext:
I got a bit carried away with a prototype low-poly helicopter game inspired by old school commodore games. 

Built with Claude Code and threejs over about 8 weeks and now on the app stores!  
  
It was lots of fun collecting sound samples - I've spent weekends recording boat engines, clock ticks, door thumps and even my daughters mooing and hope to get more samples. I'd love to record voices next!

The game is called boring helicopter game and its on the appstores now!
